conclusion: Return-conditioned KV learning produces a repeatable held-out trajectory-separation signal beyond shuffled returns and successful-action CE, but has not improved end-to-end free-form AndroidWorld success on the system tasks.

positive_only_action_auxiliary.interpretation: Best joint offline result: preserves return separation and improves ranking, but does not change top-1 decisions.

online.system_task_free_form: No successful learned-policy rollout observed, including alpha=8 and eight-step evaluations. The positive-only action auxiliary produced legal JSON (0 invalid actions) but repeated swipe-down for all eight Wi-Fi steps and returned 0.
online.candidate_ranking: All tested deterministic Wi-Fi rollouts repeatedly selected swipe-down and failed.
online.go_no_go: Do not claim end-to-end method success or start full flow/critic scaling yet. First solve structured action selection and demonstrate paired online gains.
